This template describes a standard workflow for analyzing single cell PNA data using the `pixelatorR` package in R. It covers data loading, quality control, clustering, annotation, abundance, proximity, optional statistical testing, optional single-cell graph visualization, and optional data interpretation.

This project analyses PNA data from two batches together (16 samples, 11 donors; tisa-cel and axi-cel CAR-T products at t0 and PBMC at t1). PXL files are read in place from `pna_1/` and `pna_2/`.

**Important:** Users must actively review and adjust quality control thresholds, select markers, and most critically, perform manual cell type annotation based on marker expression patterns. Automated annotation provides a starting point but should always be verified and refined through careful inspection of differential abundance patterns and marker distributions.

**How to run interactively:** Open and run the numbered notebooks in `modules/` in order (`01` through `04`; `05`, `05b` and `06` are optional). Start with `01_quality_control.qmd`. Platelet removal from the T cell graphs is a separate long run (`02b`), followed by the repeated T cell analyses in `modules_cleaned/` (render `proxiome_analysis_platelet_cleaned.qmd`). Manuscript figures (Figure 7 and supplementary panels) are generated in `08_manuscript_figures.qmd`. The separate `pna_3` validation set reads this project's platelet-cleaned object, so keep this folder's name and location unchanged. R packages come from the shared renv project in the root directory (`renv::restore()`); open the project from the `.Rproj` file in this folder so it loads automatically.

**How to re-render everything:** Render this file when you want a single HTML report of the full workflow at the end of a project (requires [Quarto](https://quarto.org/)). This report covers modules `01`–`05b` on the original object; `02b`, `08` and the cleaned modules are run separately.

**Where to edit:** Steps that depend on your experiment are labeled **Decision checkpoint** in each module. Search for **Decision checkpoint** in the module you are running.

## Project Folder Structure

```         
.
├── data/
│   └── metadata.csv                   # PXL files are read from ../pna_1/data and ../pna_2/data
│
├── modules/
│   ├── common_setup.R                 # Shared setup (sourced automatically)
│   ├── marker_selection_functions.R   # CLR-based marker selection helpers
│   ├── platelet_cleanup_functions.R   # Helpers for 02b
│   ├── 01_quality_control.qmd
│   ├── 02_clustering_annotation.qmd
│   ├── 02b_platelet_cleanup.qmd       # Platelet removal from T cell graphs (separate long run)
│   ├── 03_abundance.qmd
│   ├── 04_proximity.qmd
│   ├── 05_statistical_testing.qmd     # Optional
│   ├── 05b_statistical_testing_response.qmd # Optional: response status, axi-cel t1
│   ├── 06_cell_visualization.qmd      # Optional (not included in this render)
│   └── 08_manuscript_figures.qmd      # Figure 7 and supplementary panels (separate run)
│
├── modules_cleaned/                   # Modules 03, 04, 05, 05b on the platelet-cleaned T cell object
│   ├── 00_setup_cleaned.R
│   ├── 03_abundance_cleaned.qmd
│   ├── 04_proximity_cleaned.qmd
│   ├── 05_statistical_testing_cleaned.qmd
│   └── 05b_statistical_testing_response_cleaned.qmd
│
├── proxiome_analysis_platelet_cleaned.qmd # Full re-render of the cleaned modules
│
├── results/
│   ├── checkpoint_data/               # Saved between modules
│   │   ├── pg_data_merged.rds         # After module 01 (QC-filtered)
│   │   ├── selected_markers.rds       # After module 01
│   │   ├── annotated_seurat_object.rds # After module 02
│   │   ├── markers_to_test.rds        # After module 02
│   │   ├── platelet_tcell_protein_weights.rds # After module 02
│   │   └── pg_data_platelet_cleaned.rds # After module 02b
│   ├── 01_quality_control/
│   ├── 02_clustering_annotation/
│   ├── 02b_platelet_cleanup/
│   ├── 03_abundance/
│   ├── 04_proximity/
│   ├── 05_statistical_testing/
│   ├── 05b_statistical_testing_response/
│   ├── 06_cell_visualization/
│   └── 08_manuscript_figures/
│
└── results_cleaned/                   # Output of modules_cleaned/
    ├── 03_abundance/
    ├── 04_proximity/
    ├── 05_statistical_testing/
    └── 05b_statistical_testing_response/
```

**Note:**

- All plots are saved in both PDF and PNG formats.
- Folder numbering (01–08, including 02b) corresponds to the analysis modules. `results_cleaned/` holds the output of `modules_cleaned/`.
